quest.title: Hereafter: Return to the Mountains
quest.description: Wang Ping'an wants to renovate Pervases' temple. You wonder how much progress he's making...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

talks.objective: Go back to the Pervases statue

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: The censer is right there. If you want to offer incense, go right ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: The temple's looking the part now...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, you've got impeccable timing, haven't you? The repairs have just been completed, and I've just finished paying the laborers.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Ah... I didn't think that it would cost this much Mora. I've more or less sunk all my earnings into this place...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: But anyway. The important thing is that the temple has been rebuilt.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Would you like to offer some incense? I made a point of getting a new Censer made.

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: Take these incense sticks. The censer's right over there.

choices.text: Have you offered any incense yet?

response.speaker: Wang Ping'an
response.text: Of course I have. I was the first to do so once the refurbishment was complete, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: All done? How do you feel?

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Wonderful. I hope that there will always be incense alight in this temple...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: I will remain here for a while. This is a quiet spot, perfect for my compilation work.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: I need to get those materials that I gathered sorted out and continue to compile my book about the Vigilant Yaksha.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: If you have the time, you can drop by this temple and check on things.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: If you ever want to offer incense, just get some from me.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'd actually love to do some repairs to the surrounding area, as well...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: The path needs repaving, with fences on either side, and we should have a flowerbed nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Hey, hey! Be careful with that! Don't damage the statue!

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: *sigh* Looks like the construction work won't be finished any time soon...
